name: oh-story-claudecode

hlido_opinion.headline: Sophisticated Chinese web-novel writing workflow for Claude Code — 2,500 stars signal real demand from Chinese-language creators, even if the niche is narrow.
hlido_opinion.body: oh-story-claudecode is a Claude Code skill pack that targets Chinese web novel ('wanwen') writers specifically — covering the full production pipeline from trending topic research through story breakdown, drafting, AI-style removal, and cover generation. The 2,500 GitHub stars for a highly specialized, Chinese-language creative tool is a strong signal that the addressed market is real and underserved. The methodology ('definite emotional satisfaction', 'explosive trend reversal', 'modular drama') reads like actual professional web-novel production knowledge rather than generic creative writing prompts. The mermaid flowchart in the README and the dual install paths (Claude Code tell-to-install and npx skills add) show distribution thinking. The limitation is narrow scope: this is a single-genre, single-language creative tool. Western or non-Chinese-novel use cases are explicitly not the target. The AI-flavor removal step ('去AI味') is a genuinely interesting production concern that signals real user research — writers using AI tools need output that doesn't read as AI-generated. Not a general-purpose writing assistant: a professional-grade tool for a specific craft.

tier_rationale: STEADY (63) because the tool is well-targeted at a real user group (Chinese web novel writers), the star count validates the market, and the methodology shows domain expertise. Not higher because the scope is narrow (one genre, one language), the T2 test couldn't access the content due to GitHub login detection, and the production value of the actual output is unverifiable from the public surface.
what_it_does_well: Full web-novel production pipeline — not a single-step writing prompt, a complete workflow
AI-flavor removal step shows real production knowledge — writers need human-feeling output
Dual install paths: Claude Code verbal install and npx skills add — accessible to both camps
2,500 stars for a niche Chinese creative tool = real demand, not viral novelty
Mermaid flowchart documents the pipeline rigorously — unusually thorough for a skill pack
what_it_fails_at: Chinese-language only — no English support or localization
Web novel genre only — not a general creative writing tool
Output quality unverifiable from public surface — the actual novel quality depends on Claude's execution
No hosted demo or example output — must install and use Claude Code to evaluate
Narrow applicability limits the addressable market outside China
best_for: Chinese web novel writers using Claude Code who want a structured production workflow
Authors writing Chinese-language serialized fiction (xianxia, urban fantasy, romance, etc.)
Creators who want AI assistance that doesn't produce obviously AI-sounding prose
Anyone building Claude Code skills for creative domains and wanting a reference implementation
not_recommended_for: Writers who need a hosted product rather than a CLI workflow
Teams that need multiple language support
